description: This file implements a Tic Tac Toe game engine with game logic, scoring, and AI move selection, designed to be UI-framework-agnostic.

classes.name: TicTacToeGame
classes.description: A class encapsulating the game state, rules, scoring, and AI move logic for Tic Tac Toe.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board while retaining the current scores.

methods.name: resetAll
methods.description: Resets the game board and all scoring, starting fresh.

methods.name: playAt
methods.description: Attempts to make a move at the specified board index. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: playComputerMove
methods.description: Performs a move for the computer player if in PvC mode and it's the computer's turn.

methods.name: getWinner
methods.description: Returns the winner of the game, or null if no winner.

methods.name: getWinningLine
methods.description: Returns the indices of the winning line, or null if there isn't one.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game ended in a draw.

methods.name: isGameOver
methods.description: Checks if the game is concluded, either by win or draw.

methods.name: updateOutcome
methods.description: Internal method to update game outcome after each move.

methods.name: findWinningLine
methods.description: Checks all possible winning lines to determine if there's a winner.

methods.name: chooseComputerMove
methods.description: Decides the computer's move based on a simple strategy.

methods.name: findImmediateWinningMove
methods.description: Checks if a player can win immediately by placing a move in an empty spot.
